name: Banyan Tree Krabi
short_description: A 5-star beachfront resort with 72 pool suites and villas on a secluded Andaman Sea beach facing jungle-clad mountains.
ai_summary: Banyan Tree Krabi sits on a secluded beach on Krabi's Andaman coast, described on its own Accor listing as a sanctuary where sapphire-blue sea meets white sand against jungle-green mountains. The resort has 72 suites and villas, each with a private pool, set among fragrant gardens and water features. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.

core_facts.address: 279 Moo 3, Tambon Nongtalay, Amphoe Muang, 81180 Krabi, Thailand

faqs.question: How many villas does Banyan Tree Krabi have?
faqs.answer: 72 suites and villas, each with a private pool, set on a secluded beach on Krabi's Andaman coast facing jungle-clad mountains. The resort is arranged among fragrant gardens and water features, though its own Accor listing did not display an aggregate guest rating at the time of research, so no rating is quoted here.
